_comment: Bundled tools of the Windows package. With "url" empty the newest GitHub release is used at build time and checked against the SHA-256 GitHub publishes for the asset; set "url" + "sha256" to pin an exact file instead. The hash of every bundled file ends up in the package manifest. Tesseract is pinned to its newest release (v5.4.0.20240606, signed by Universitaet Mannheim); clear url/sha256 to follow new releases.
